assessment.body:
Day 47 is the most diplomatically active morning of the war.

THE DIPLOMATIC SIGNAL — CLEAREST YET
• Trump (Fox Business, aired Apr 15): 'I think it's close to over, yeah. I view it as very close to being over'
• Talks expected to resume Thursday in Islamabad — multiple confirmed sources
• Pakistan PM Sharif visiting Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Turkey this week to facilitate
• Turkish FM Fidan suggests ceasefire could be extended 45-60 days for more negotiations
• UN Sec-Gen Guterres: 'highly probable' talks restart
• Vance: 'a grand deal to be had — but it's up to the Iranians to take the next step'
• BUT: US NOT formally agreed to ceasefire extension — expires Apr 21
• Key gap remains: nuclear enrichment (US: zero forever; Iran: 3-5 years at most)

BLOCKADE — WORKING BUT ESCALATING IRAN
• CENTCOM: 'completely halted economic trade going into and out of Iran by sea'
• Day 1: 10,000+ US personnel, 12+ warships, dozens of aircraft — zero ships breached
• 6 commercial ships redirected back to Iranian ports
• 4 Iran-linked ships on Apr 14 — all sanctioned, all under watch; Rich Starry reversed
• Iran's economic pain: $435M/day loss. Storage fills in ~13 days — then forced production shutdown
• But Iran's response is concerning: threatening to shut Red Sea + Gulf of Oman + Persian Gulf

IRAN'S RED SEA THREAT — INDIA EXPOSURE EXPANDS
• Gen. Abdollahi: if blockade continues, Iran 'would not allow any exports or imports to continue in the Persian Gulf, the Sea of Oman, and the Red Sea'
• Red Sea closure would affect Suez Canal route — India's alternative to Hormuz
• Would cut both India's oil import routes simultaneously
• India 85%+ Hormuz dependent; western coast shipping also uses Red Sea via Suez
• This is Iran's nuclear option in trade war terms

INDIA MARKET OUTLOOK — TODAY'S OPEN
• BSE/NSE reopen after 2-day break
• GIFT Nifty 24,205 (-0.02%) at 8:09 AM IST — near-flat open
• Brent ~$97-98 — below $100 positive for India
• If Thursday talks confirm formally before market close: Sensex could rally to 77,500-78,000
• If Iran acts on Red Sea threat: extreme negative — both oil import routes compromised
• Wipro Q4 results Apr 16; Infosys results this week — IT sector a positive catalyst
• Emkay: Nifty target 29,000 Mar 2027 (if permanent deal). Morgan Stanley: Sensex ₹95,000 Dec 2026

KEY DATE: APRIL 21 — CEASEFIRE EXPIRY (6 DAYS)
• Scenario A (most likely ~55%): Talks resume Thursday, ceasefire extended 45-60 days — Brent drops to $75-80, Sensex rallies 5-10%
• Scenario B (~30%): No deal but ceasefire extended — status quo continues, oil stable ~$95-100
• Scenario C (~15%): No deal, no extension, ceasefire lapses — IRGC maximum alert + Trump strikes resume = extreme escalation, Nifty could test 20,000
• Trump's 'very close to over' + Thursday talks signal is the strongest positive yet

VERDICT: Thursday is the most important day of the war for markets. If talks confirm formally and ceasefire extends, India gets the relief it needs. If they fail, Apr 21 becomes a genuine crisis point. Iran's Red Sea threat is the most dangerous new escalation — watch for any action on this. India has 6-8 weeks fuel buffer but the clock is ticking.
